title: HybridStitch: Token-Adaptive Model Stitching for Efficient Diffusion Generation
abstract: arXiv:2603.07815v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Iterative diffusion generation requires different amounts of model capacity at different token positions. Prior model combinations allocate capacity by denoising step or by drafting and verification role. We present HybridStitch, a training-free framework that uses token-level feedback to select the model supplying each adopted update. Continuous image refinement and discrete language commitment operate on a shared generation state, while model-specific KV buffers provide attention context for selected queries. HybridStitch achieves 1.63--1.68$\times$ faster image generation and 1.15--1.58$\times$ diffusion large language model (dLLM) throughput on four main benchmarks. Estimated dLLM decode query cost decreases by 50--66% with comparable generation quality.

translated_title: HybridStitch：面向高效扩散生成的token自适应模型拼接
translated_abstract: 迭代式扩散生成在不同的token位置需要不同数量的模型容量。先前的模型组合方法按照去噪步骤或按照草稿与验证的角色来分配容量。我们提出HybridStitch，这是一个无需训练的框架，它利用token级别的反馈来选择提供每个被采纳更新的模型。连续的图像精炼和离散的语言承诺在共享的生成状态上运行，同时模型特定的KV缓存为被选中的查询提供注意力上下文。在四个主要基准测试中，HybridStitch实现了1.63--1.68倍的图像生成加速和1.15--1.58倍的扩散大语言模型（dLLM）吞吐量提升。在生成质量相当的情况下，估计的dLLM解码查询成本降低了50--66%。
tldr: HybridStitch是一种无需训练的模型拼接框架，通过token级反馈自适应选择不同模型提供更新，实现图像生成加速1.63--1.68倍、扩散大语言模型吞吐量提升1.15--1.58倍，并将dLLM解码查询成本降低50--66%。
en_tdlr: HybridStitch is a training-free model stitching framework that adaptively selects which model supplies each token-level update via token-level feedback, achieving 1.63--1.68× faster image generation, 1.15--1.58× higher dLLM throughput, and a 50--66% reduction in dLLM decode query cost.
